intent.description:
Inspect this machine with the DevSweep CLI and return cleanup advice or
optimization advice for developer caches and disk space. Use when the user
asks to 检查本机, 磁盘清理建议, 释放空间, 开发缓存, or 优化建议; or says
inspect disk space, developer cache, recommend cleanup, or optimization
advice. Do not use for clean execute, software uninstall, TUI work, rm -rf,
or PowerShell Remove-Item deletion.
intent.job_to_be_done: Inspect this machine with the DevSweep CLI and return evidence-backed cleanup and optimization advice without side effects.
target_users: coding agents working in the DevSweep repository
developers who ask an agent to inspect disk space or developer caches
outputs: optional new observation JSON or untrusted Cleanup Plan file

should_trigger: 检查本机，给出磁盘清理建议
看看开发缓存占了多少 disk space
recommend cleanup for this machine, inspect disk space first
给出优化建议，并检查本机开发缓存
Use DevSweep to inspect disk space and return cleanup advice
本机开发缓存太大，先给我清理建议和释放空间估计
near_neighbor: 执行清理，run clean execute now
rm -rf node_modules and Remove-Item the cache

compact_workflow: Locate the DevSweep program. In this repo use `cargo run --locked -p devsweep-cli --bin devsweep --`. Prefer an installed `devsweep` when `devsweep --version` works.

Route the request with [references/cli-playbook.md](references/cli-playbook.md). Default to `clean scan --scope all --format json --output <new-file>`. Use `analyze scan` when the user wants tree usage without cleanup authority. Use `optimize list` for the Windows catalogue. Use `status snapshot` for a machine snapshot.
Keep program and argv separate. Do not compose a shell cleanup string.

Read the JSON result. Build the recommendation report from [references/recommendation-report.md](references/recommendation-report.md). Use Cleanup Target, Scan Report, Cleanup Plan, Estimated Recoverable, and Inspect Only.
Save `clean plan` only when the user asked for a plan file. The file stays an untrusted Cleanup Plan.
Stop. Do not run `clean execute`, `optimize run`, `software uninstall`, or protection mutations. Say that execution needs a later explicit request plus preview digest and `--confirm`.
output_contract: Name the inspect command and roots that actually ran.
Split Estimated Recoverable into verified, partial-lower-bound, and unknown.
Table Cleanup Targets with id, path, evidence, risk, class, and advice `recommend` / `inspect-only` / `exclude`.
Call out Inspect Only rows, including Cargo home.
Treat Optimize list rows as catalogue facts, not completed maintenance.
End with the execute-later next step. Omit execute argv from the default report.

trust.remote_metadata_policy: allow catalog metadata and read-only source review; forbid unreviewed execution

permissions.file_write: optional new observation or untrusted plan JSON via DevSweep --output create-new
permissions.subprocess: DevSweep inspect commands only; cargo run for the repo binary

scaffold: README hook and natural trigger examples

evidence_boundary.public_claim_policy: claim only what local validation, install proof, human review, or provider-backed evidence actually supports
